decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the construction of a  single-storey rear extension to the dwelling house at 19 Thornbury Avenue would not harm the appearance the existing building or the character of the surrounding Conservation Area, and would protect neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development),ENV-B 2.2, (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) within the Unitary Development Plan (December 2003), and the relevant provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The extension hereby perrmitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 19Thornbury Avenue.
description: Erection of a single-storey rear extension to house
